verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot documents cloud agents, automations, and a control plane to launch, track, and manage multiple agent sessions in parallel with scheduling and isolated sandboxes, supporting background autonomous work (docs-3,8,14,15,16,23). However, there's no community/hands-on evidence confirming multi-day/hour-long autonomous parallel fleets actually work at scale, and most community feedback focuses on inline completion/chat quality rather than long-running autonomous agent fleets.
